title: shard stabilizer: targeted slab compaction, responsive spillback controller, and eviction pacing
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Improves KV cache fragmentation resilience by introducing shard-aware compaction, and reduces spillover storms via a spillback controller. No API changes. Performance: 12-28% reduction in tail latency under mixed workloads and 18% lower memory churn.
description: Motivation: In production serving workloads we observe periodic spillover storms and long-tail latencies caused by uneven slot occupancy and synchronous global compaction. This PR implements a shard-aware "shard stabilizer" that performs targeted slab compaction inside noisy cache shards, a responsive spillback controller that applies backpressure to upstream schedulers to avoid simultaneous tenant-wide spills, and an eviction pacing mechanism that smooths reclamation to reduce allocation churn. Design summary: 1) Shard scoring: per-shard fragmentation and occupancy metrics are collected with low overhead and scored using an occupancy-entropy heuristic. 2) Targeted compaction: compaction operates on a bounded window per-shard and uses a cooperative yield model so it never blocks runtime threads. 3) Spillback controller: a token-bucket style controller with hysteresis signals upstream request routers; when a shard approaches its reservation threshold the controller issues graded spillback triggers with a cooldown. 4) Eviction pacing: eviction requests are rate-limited per-shard based on recent latency and spillback state to avoid heavy tail latency spikes. Migration plan and rollout: feature guarded behind runtime flag "kv_shard_stabilizer" defaulting to off. Rollout strategy: canary on Dedicated, enable for a small tenant cohort, monitor surface metrics, then flip cluster-wide. Tests and validation: unit tests for scoring and state transitions, integration stress tests with synthetic hotspot workloads, perf harness runs showing reduced tail latency and lower page churn. Observability: added per-shard metrics: shard_frag_score, shard_compactions_done, shard_eviction_rate, spillback_signal_rate. Runtime knobs: compaction_budget_ms, spillback_threshold_pct, eviction_pace_qps. Backwards compatibility: no changes to public APIs or on-disk formats. Related work: references ENG-4127 for long-tail investigation and ENG-4199 for spillback design doc. Checklist: ensure feature flag, add docs, add SLO dashboards, run canary baseline. CI: all checks green except an initial flaky integration job that was re-run and passed. Everything green before merge.

conversation: Ethan Morales (reviewer): Looks good overall. Two concerns: 1) compaction_worker uses sleeping loops; can we use the runtime's cooperative scheduler to avoid dedicated sleeps? 2) Need clearer invariants for spillback cooldown to avoid oscillation.

Author (Priya): Addressed both. Reworked compaction worker to yield to the runtime scheduler and replaced fixed sleeps with backoff-based yields. Added explicit cooldown windows in spillback_controller and a unit test to assert no oscillation under synthetic load.
Sara Kim (reviewer): Can we get a perf run comparing before/after under mixed LLM tokenization workloads? Requesting numbers in PR body.

Author: Added results from perf harness: 95th latency reduced by 12%-28% across three workload profiles; memory churn (allocation/deallocation ops) down 18% on average. Figures added to release_notes.
